evidence: commit dff549e -- Task 4 (F2 app-half closed: auth gate enforced by default)
commit 7a008ad -- Task 5 (F2 infra-half closed: mcp-auth-token resolved from Key Vault)
assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's external boundary (ingressExternal: true) had no inbound authentication, so the estate's external communications boundary was neither monitored nor controlled for anyone who discovered the FQDN. F1 is now CLOSED (Task 6): infra/bicep/apps/main.bicep's dataApiApp module sets ingressExternal:false, so data-api is no longer an external boundary at all — it is reachable only from inside the Container Apps environment, through the nginx proxy both frontends already ran. F2: mcp-tools' external boundary is required to stay open (Copilot Studio calls it from the internet); the auth gate meant to protect that boundary was inert in the shipped configuration, so the control the repo advertises most prominently at its key internal/external boundary was not actually enforced. F2 is now CLOSED (Tasks 4 and 5). Task 4 closed the application half: enforcement no longer keys off backendMode, so the gate now fails closed at this boundary by default in every mode, and is mounted ahead of the body parser so an unauthenticated caller cannot make the process do work before the boundary check runs. Task 5 closed the infra half: MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS is now set explicitly (mcpToolsBackendMode, default 'local') rather than being absent, and the token the boundary check compares against is resolved from the platform Key Vault at runtime via the mcp-tools UAMI's Key Vault Secrets User grant (keyVaultUrl reference, infra/bicep/apps/main.bicep module mcpKvGrant) rather than depending on an operator remembering to wire a secure parameter through infra/ or CI that nothing ever did. Overall status is now CLOSED: both findings this control cites are closed — the estate's remaining external boundary (mcp-tools) is authenticated by design, and data-api no longer has an external boundary to authenticate. This control has no other open contributors (checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.13.1).

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. (Setting ingressExternal:false on data-api, Task 6, and the MCP auth gate default and Key Vault token resolution for mcp-tools' boundary, Tasks 4 and 5, are all DONE.) A regression here — external ingress re-added to data-api, or the mcp-tools auth gate re-keyed to a mode that isn't shipped — would reopen this control.
